title: Laragon local dev testing setup
summary: Windows developers can run MyAPES Core on a Laragon Apache virtual host with a dedicated env profile, bootstrap switch, and dev launcher that skips artisan serve.
changes: Add .env.laragon.example with vhost URLs and VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL for Laragon Apache workflows.
Extend bootstrap.ps1 with -Laragon and optional -AppUrl for SQLite QA setup on a .test hostname.
Add composer run dev:laragon and dev-laragon.ps1 so Vite, queue, and logs run without php artisan serve.
Tune Vite dev-server HMR settings for pages served from a Laragon virtual host.
Document Laragon prerequisites, vhost setup, daily dev loop, and troubleshooting in README and AGENTS.md.
affected_areas: Local bootstrap and dev launcher scripts
version_rationale: Patch release: local development tooling and documentation only; no production application behaviour change.
validation: node --test scripts/local/dev-runner.test.mjs including Laragon mode without artisan serve.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main after filling release notes.
known_limitations: Laragon virtual-host verification requires a local Laragon Apache install; the default composer run dev path on 127.0.0.1:8000 is unchanged.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. To remove Laragon support, revert the Laragon env example, bootstrap switch, dev:laragon launcher, Vite HMR tweak, and README or AGENTS guidance from this release.
provenance: Defined by the Laragon local dev testing setup for MyAPES Account issue #173.
